resources.string: Enhances WeChat and media notifications with modern libxposed API 102.
Restart the affected target process after changing a setting. WeChat enhancement is enabled by default; optional system-wide enhancements are disabled by default.
Stretch the single-lined list into multi-lined for list-style notifications, to make the most of the available space when there are only a few lines.
Stack historical messages within the same slot as a list in expanded form.
Expand truncated single-line text into multi-line long text.
Hide sticky notifications. (snooze a sticky notification to trigger)
Notification is hidden until next boot.
Better notification for WeChat: Messaging Style, Direct Reply and Clear to Mark Read.
Show the received picture instead of [图片] in the notification. Requires a WeChat process restart after changing; with this off, notifications keep the original [图片] text.
